title: Encode options, JSON form
description: Options for encodeMatch as used by the test vectors. The TypeScript API also accepts a function for uuids. The codec additionally rejects repeated UUIDs and too few UUIDs for the parts a match needs.

uuids.description: One envelope UUID per code, in part order. Extra entries are ignored.

maxPayloadBytes.description: Largest UTF-8 length of any returned payload text.
